findings.text: The negative-control logs stamp '# revision: d7d3cba9bd10f30683d0f2a5eabb62c4ec832a5a', the base commit, but the tree they measured was the head copy of the test file with the XDG_RUNTIME_DIR line removed: the traceback lands on tests/test_reviews_read_the_committed_store_first.py:254, which is head line 255 shifted by the single deleted line, while the base file asserts at line 248. The control is therefore the right mutation and its population is right, but a reader who compares the header's revision against the tree it measured cannot tell which code the red run exercised; a tree-state line naming the mutation (or the mutation recorded beside the log) would make the control auditable from the log alone.
